security-bot: :rotating_light: Suspicious access pattern detected: high read rate on vault path secret/data/backups from external IP 34.128.22.11 at 2026-03-20T08:12:03Z
alex: saw that, digging in. looks like a partner sync job pulled an S3 backup that includes wrapped tokens?
morgan: confirmed — dev-tools reported a leaked backup blob in partner-bucket. blob name: backups/2026-03-19-22-18.tar.enc
jia: is this the KMS-wrapped backup we use for offsite? if so we need to assume transit key exposure until proven otherwise.
aj: oncall taking this — started containment checklist. assigning tasks: rotate KMS key, disable partner sync, revoke vault tokens, audit logs, and rewrap CI secrets.
alex: presuming GCP KMS. command to disable key versions: `gcloud kms keys versions disable --key=redwood-transit --location=global --keyring=prod-kr --version=3` (run after confirming current version)
morgan: stopping partner pipeline now: `gsutil lifecycle set` and removed service account from bucket ACLs. partner notified (ticket #ZE-442).
chris: I'm pulling Vault audit logs. running: `vault audit list` and `gcloud logging read "resource.type=project AND logName=..." --limit=1000` to find IPs and tokens used.
jia: note: don't delete KMS key yet — disable new versions and rotate to new key material, then rewrap. schedule for rewrap: re-encrypt backups with new key and push to partner bucket with short TTL.
aj: alex, can you do immediate revocation of long-lived Vault tokens and service tokens? I can revoke app-level creds after you list them.
alex: running `vault token revoke -prefix admin-` and `vault lease revoke -prefix` for known prefixes. posting results in a sec.
security-bot: automation: created incident ticket SEC-2026-033, set severity P1, added runbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/sec-playbooks/kms-vault-compromise
morgan: ops step done: partner pipeline paused, bucket ACLs cleaned, partner asked to hold restore attempts.
achj: (typo) sorry meant aj: updated.
aj: audit results?
chris: found three distinct external IPs accessing the vault path between 22:00-22:30 UTC. two accesses succeeded for `secret/data/backups/` and one had a 403. captured request IDs and useragent `curl/7.80`
alex: revoked 4 tokens tied to svc accounts: `svc-backup-prod-01`, `svc-etl-legacy`. added a block on those SA keys in IAM.
jia: KMS plan: create new key ring `prod-kr-2` -> new key `redwood-transit-v2`, update rewrap script: `gcloud kms cryptokeys versions rotate` then run rewrap: `python tools/rewrap_backups.py --src-key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr/cryptoKeys/redwood-transit --dest-key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod-kr-2/cryptoKeys/redwood-transit-v2 backups/*.enc`
morgan: will throttle partner restores; we need a timeline: rotate keys within 2 hours, rewrap over night, full verification tomorrow morning. partner OK with window.
aj: I'm coordinating RBAC lockout: temporarily restrict vault read to only `svc-secrets-sync` and audit all `acl: allow` grants. Anyone object?
chris: no objections. I recommend enabling vault HSM rewrap logging and increasing audit retention to 90 days for this incident.
alex: quick PSA to devs: `If you pulled backups from partner-bucket between 2026-03-19T20:00Z and 2026-03-19T23:59Z, rotate any credentials embedded in those backups now.` posted to #general and #product-safety.
morgan: I'm drafting the customer-facing blurb for partner ops. keeping it factual: suspected exfil of encrypted backups, keys rotated, no plaintext creds found so far.
aj: handoff: I'll stay on this for the next 3 hours, then schedule a 09:00UTC followup with CHRIS and JIA. action items assigned in SEC-2026-033: rotate-kms, revoke-tokens, rewrap-backups, RBAC-tighten, audit-collection.
security-bot: reminder: run `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` if not already enabled.
jia: final note: after key rotation, we must re-encrypt CI artifact store and rotate CI tokens in parallel. add `ci-run` to the rotation list.
alex: ack. starting CI token rotation now.
achj: (typo again) chris: will upload extracted logs to secure storage and link in ticket. :thumbsup: 
aj: thanks everyone — keep replies short in this thread, updates in the incident ticket. :lock:
